Subject: RE: Yarden Logistics - New Submission

Hi Avery,

Thanks for the submission on Yarden Logistics! I've reviewed the materials and everything looks good to move forward.

I have a few questions before I can finalize the quote:

- Can you confirm the primary operations at each of the three locations?
- Are there any special hazards or processes we should be aware of (e.g., hazmat storage, cold storage)?
- What are the current protection classes for each location?
- Any planned changes to operations or expansions in the next 12 months?

Once I have these details, I'll work up a competitive proposal for you. Looking forward to hearing back!

Best regards,

[Underwriter name]
